goals.description: Create a Unified University Inventory System that combines inventory databases of three faculties and provides access through a secure web interface.

source.quote: A university needs a Unified University Inventory System that combines the inventory databases of three faculties and makes the integrated inventory available through a secure web interface.

responsibilities.description: Manage assets such as rooms, software licences, and equipment.

source.quote: University, faculty, and department staff need to manage assets such as rooms, software licences, and equipment

responsibilities.description: Request assets or reserve spaces for approval by the appropriate administrative level.

source.quote: other users should be able to request assets or reserve spaces for approval by the appropriate administrative level.

responsibilities.description: Explains asset request and space reservation workflows.

source.quote: A faculty inventory representative explains asset request and space reservation workflows
and participates in user acceptance testing.

responsibilities.description: Defines priorities, approves business requirements, and makes the final release decision.

source.quote: The Product Owner defines priorities, approves business requirements, and makes the final release decision.

responsibilities.description: Approves the user acceptance testing results.

source.quote: The Product Owner approves the user acceptance testing results.

responsibilities.description: Gathers and clarifies requirements, prepares the specification, and maintains links between requirements and implementation tasks.

source.quote: The Business Analyst gathers and clarifies requirements, prepares the specification, and maintains links between requirements and implementation tasks.

responsibilities.description: Makes technical implementation decisions, develops the application, and deploys releases.

source.quote: The Full-stack Developer makes technical implementation decisions, develops the application, and deploys releases.

responsibilities.description: Prepares and executes tests, records defects, and reports whether the release meets the agreed acceptance criteria.

source.quote: The QA Engineer prepares and executes tests, records defects, and reports whether the release meets the agreed acceptance criteria.

requirements.description: System shall combine inventory databases of three faculties.

source.quote: combines the inventory databases of three faculties

requirements.description: Integrated inventory shall be available through a secure web interface.

source.quote: makes the integrated inventory available through a secure web interface.

requirements.description: Staff shall be able to manage assets.

source.quote: University, faculty, and department staff need to manage assets such as rooms, software licences, and equipment

requirements.description: Other users shall be able to request assets.

source.quote: other users should be able to request assets

requirements.description: Other users shall be able to reserve spaces.

source.quote: or reserve spaces for approval by the appropriate administrative level.

requirements.description: Room reservations must be approved by the owning faculty administrator before confirmation.

source.quote: Every room reservation must be approved by the owning faculty administrator before confirmation.

requirements.description: Room reservations shall be confirmed immediately without administrator approval.

source.quote: Every room reservation is confirmed immediately without administrator approval.

missing_information.why_needed: The brief mentions different groups needing to manage assets or request items, but the specific permission levels for each role are not defined.

contradictions.description: Room reservation approval process is simultaneously required to be approved by an administrator and to be confirmed automatically.

questions.text: Should room reservations be confirmed automatically or only after approval by an administrator?
Could you define the specific roles and permission levels required for users to manage assets versus requesting them?
